core_obligations: The equivalence (proof lines 8363-8367): the first assertion is taken from the companion remark, and the author recalls the description of the equivalence by the sheaf of maps into the set.
The morphism of sites (proof lines 8368-8371): the second assertion is clear from the definitions of a point and of a morphism of sites.
The composition (proof lines 8372-8378): the author computes the composite of the two pushforwards on a set and identifies it with the pushforward along the point by the recalled description.
proof_roadmap: Recall the equivalence and the description of its direct image.
Check that the functor defines a morphism of sites from the definitions.
Compute the composite of the pushforwards and identify it with the pushforward along the point.
difficulty_reason: The lemma represents a point of a site as a morphism of sites from the site built out of a sufficiently large powerset, in such a way that the induced morphism of topoi is the given point (statement lines 8338-8360). The proof is short and complete: the equivalence is recalled from the companion remark together with the description of its direct image (proof lines 8363-8367); the functor is checked to define a morphism of sites directly from the definitions (proof lines 8368-8371); and the composite of the pushforwards is computed and identified with the pushforward along the point (proof lines 8372-8378). The non-formal content is the computation of the composite. The claim is H1: three short steps, each written out.
